title: Le Passé Composé vs Le Plus-Que-Parfait

items.translation: What had already happened before that event
items.exampleFr: Il m'a dit qu'il avait déménagé.
items.exampleEn: He told me that he had moved house.

items.prompt: Quand je suis arrivé, le train ___.
items.translation: When I arrived, the train had already left.

items.prompt: Elle a lu le livre que je lui ___.
items.translation: She read the book I had lent her.

items.prompt: Il était fatigué parce qu'il ___ toute la nuit.
items.translation: He was tired because he had worked all night.

items.prompt: Nous avons mangé le gâteau que maman ___.
items.translation: We ate the cake that Mum had made.

items.prompt: J'ai retrouvé les clés que j'___.
items.translation: I found the keys I had lost.

items.prompt: Quand nous sommes arrivés, le film ___.
items.translation: When we arrived, the film had already started.

items.prompt: Elle ne voulait pas dîner : elle ___.
items.translation: She did not want dinner: she had already eaten.
Yesterday, I met Paul at the market.

items.prompt: Il m'a dit qu'il ___ ce film la semaine d'avant.
items.translation: He told me he had seen that film the week before.

items.prompt: Ils sont rentrés à pied parce qu'ils ___ le dernier bus.
items.translation: They walked home because they had missed the last bus.

items.prompt: Ce matin, elle ___ à huit heures.
items.translation: This morning, she left at eight.

items.prompt: Je n'avais pas faim parce que j'___ un sandwich.
items.translation: I was not hungry because I had had a sandwich.

items.prompt: In “Quand il est arrivé, j'avais fini”, which action happened first?
Which form is the plus-que-parfait of “voir” (je)?
In French: “He said that he had finished.”
items.answer: Il a dit qu'il avait fini

items.prompt: In French: “We had never seen that.”
